name: Pork Sausage and Cauliflower Cheese Bake
fit_evidence: Published 407 cal / 6.6g carbs / 25g protein per serving - inside 400-650 cal and <=35g carb; no seafood; cream-cheese-and-gruyere-bound cauliflower bake with no starch base scales cleanly to 14 in a hotel pan. Flag: 407 sits at the floor, a label-DB recompute could dip under 400.
catalog_evidence: No in-protein (pork) collision in the 544-recipe digest. Nearest catalog neighbor is cheesy-smoked-sausage-rice-skillet, which is a rice skillet with broccoli - different starch base and different dish. Not a catalog duplicate.
pool_note: Chosen as the survivor of an in-batch collision with cheesy-cauliflower-mac-smoked-sausage-bake (both are pork-sausage + cauliflower + cheese oven bakes - same four axes). Kept this one over the American mac version because British cauliflower-cheese widens the catalog's American/Tex-Mex skew and it carries lower carbs (6.6 vs 10) with more calorie headroom.
cross_protein_collisions: Structurally this is a sausage-and-cauliflower-cheese bake; a turkey- or chicken-sausage version of the same casserole in another selector's pool would be the same dinner. Decider should watch for a *-sausage-cauliflower-cheese-bake twin.

Also collides in silhouette with any crustless cauliflower-cheese bake carrying a different pork cut (bacon/ham) - e.g. accepted chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake is a different flavor family (bacon-ranch chicken) so NOT a dupe, but flagging the cauliflower-cheese-bake cluster for the cross-protein merge pass.
unmapped_ok: Carries fresh pork sausage links and Gruyere as unmapped - per v2.1 5.1 these absent-ingredient picks are wanted for the pricer lane, not penalized.
